definitions.gloss: crackling; snapping; the sound of sparks or larger flames
definitions.explanation: The sound of something crackling sharply and repeatedly, such as a large fire, sparks from electricity, or oil splattering. Represents a louder, sharper crackling than ぱちぱち.

examples.japanese: {焚火|たきび}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧バチバチ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{燃|も}えている→燃える：02312_moeru⟧。
examples.english: The bonfire is crackling and burning.

examples.japanese: ⟦{電線|でんせん}→電線：11507_densen⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧バチバチ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{火花|ひばな}→火花：13378_hibana⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{散|ち}らした→散らす：02288_chirasu⟧。
examples.english: The power line crackled and sent out sparks.

examples.japanese: ⟦{鉄板|てっぱん}→鉄板：14470_teppan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{上|うえ}→上：00682_ue⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{油|あぶら}→油：01693_abura⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧バチバチ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧はねて、⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{飛|と}んで→飛ぶ：00759_tobu⟧きた。
examples.english: Oil was splattering noisily on the iron griddle and flying up to my face.

notes:
A mimetic/onomatopoeic word for sharp, repeated crackling sounds — louder and more intense than ⟦ぱちぱち→ぱちぱち：05889_pachipachi⟧.

USAGE:
- ⟦{火|ひ}→火：02248_hi⟧/{焚火|たきび}: crackling fire
- ⟦{静電気|せいでんき}→静電気：18522_seidenki⟧: static electricity sparking
- ⟦{油|あぶら}→油：01693_abura⟧/⟦{揚|あ}げ{物|もの}→揚げ物：04975_agemono⟧: oil splattering when frying
- ⟦{電気|でんき}→電気：09780_denki⟧: electrical sparking

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ぱちぱち→ぱちぱち：05889_pachipachi⟧: lighter crackling (small fire, applause, flapping) — softer than バチバチ
- バリバリ: sharp tearing or crunching — suggests more force
- パチパチ: same word in katakana for emphasis or electrical connotation
